entities.summary: Fillìa was the name adopted by Luigi Colombo, an Italian artist associated with the second generation of Futurism. Aside from painting, his works included interior design, architecture, furniture and decorative objects. Fillìa was a painters & sculptors from Revello (1904-10-04, Revello–1936-02-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
